consequence.statement: A new operator metric is available. The evidence lists no setting or workload that it breaks or changes.

original.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 adds a new metric, cilium_operator_unmanaged_pods, which the upgrade notes list under Added Metrics.

decision.reason: [ev-b182e7794768] lists `cilium_operator_unmanaged_pods` only under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics". The surrounding section is just a list of newly added metrics ([ev-b598b51801ea], [ev-b66b29e5567d]) and says nothing about anything failing, being rejected or behaving differently. A new metric that an operator can ignore has no operational consequence, so kind "none" (informational) is what the evidence supports.
